subject.title: fix(cron): mark interrupted restart runs failed instead of lost

question: Should maintainers accept this PR's combined durable cron recovery change and new public cron-store SDK helper after exact-head CI is green?
rationale: The code path looks like the right owner-boundary fix, but it changes persistent cron recovery semantics and plugin SDK surface area, which are maintainer-owned compatibility decisions.

options.title: Accept after green checks
options.body: Land the current branch once the failed/pending exact-head checks are clean, treating the new cron-store SDK helper and revision refresh path as the intended contract.

options.title: Narrow the public surface
options.body: Ask the author to keep the row-level delivery-target helper internal or otherwise prove why third-party plugins should receive this SDK export now.

options.title: Ask for full restart proof
options.body: Require a redacted full gateway stop/restart transcript before merge if runtime-level SQLite proof is not enough for this session-state change.

recommendation.title: Accept after green checks
recommendation.body: Land the current branch once the failed/pending exact-head checks are clean, treating the new cron-store SDK helper and revision refresh path as the intended contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is assigned, has recent main history in cron/store/plugin SDK areas, and authored several current branch commits after the force-push.
